**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Chat
- **No more silent hangs on web-grounded replies.** A Gemini reply that stops making progress — typically after several Google Search rounds, where the connection stayed open but no text ever arrived — is now cut off after 45 seconds and sent again automatically. If it stalls a second time you get an error right away instead of waiting up to five minutes. A reply that had already started streaming keeps the text it produced.
- **"Searching the web…"** is shown next to the typing indicator while a grounded reply is still running its search rounds, so you can tell searching apart from a stuck request.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.16...v8.17
